## What is this?

This is your "howdy, world" GitHub repo.
You can clone this from Rstudio:

- New project
- From "Version control"
- Paste the url `https://github.com/TeachHealthData/gitty-up-ids26.git`

## How to contribute to it

Then you can create a new qmd file - name it as your student number (s123456.qmd).
This is important - don't add any other "useful" information into this filename.

Then commit your file, and push to GitHub using either the RStudio Git pane or GitHub Desktop, as you prefer.


## How to see other people's contributions

Again using the RStudio Git pane, or GitHub Desktop, pull from the remote.

This will bring the changes to your local machine.

Next you can render the Quarto project.

All rendered files will be placed into the directory `COHORT-PAGES`.

Open that and then open the file `index.html` in your browser.
